response.original_title: Novel Experiences: The BBC Books Adventures
response.overview: Presenter Robert Dick explores the original Doctor Who novels published by BBC Books between 1999 and 2005, when more than 100 Eighth Doctor and Past Doctor adventures kept the series alive in print before its return to television. Contributors and fans look back at the range. Filmed around the Whoovers event at QUAD, Derby, in May 2023.
